posts.text: This seems to be more interesting biz model than data centrer. Just a year old and scaling rapidly. I assume other pure Indian players are Jio and Tata Communications. Bharti Airtel's cloud platform has quickly gained traction, hitting around 40 customers within a year, with manufacturing firms making up 25% of the client base, highlighting the rise of sovereign cloud demand in India.
